panels.description: Counts every run by its current recorded status, using started_at or requested_at when never started. Buckets are UTC calendar days; timestamps display in the dashboard timezone.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CAST(DATE(COALESCE(started_at, requested_at)) AS DATETIME) AS `Day`,
  SUM(status = 'completed') AS `Completed`,
  SUM(status = 'timed_out') AS `Timed out`,
  SUM(status = 'uncertain') AS `Uncertain`,
  SUM(status = 'reviewed') AS `Reviewed`,
  SUM(status = 'pending') AS `Pending`,
  SUM(status = 'running') AS `Running`,
  SUM(status = 'break') AS `Break`,
  SUM(status = 'cancelled') AS `Cancelled`
FROM watering_run
WHERE COALESCE(started_at, requested_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY `Day`
ORDER BY `Day`

panels.title: Run outcomes

panels.description: Completed automatic cycles sum both confirmed stage intervals, excluding the OFF break. Legacy/manual runs use their confirmed elapsed interval. Calibration remains 67 seconds = 500 ml; reviewed timestamps are operator acknowledgements.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  r.id AS `Run ID`,
  r.status AS `Status`,
  r.started_at AS `Started at`,
  r.finished_at AS `Ended at`,
  r.actual_seconds AS `Actual duration (seconds)`,
  ROUND(r.actual_seconds * 500.0 / 67.0, 1) AS `Estimated volume (ml)`,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(s.position, ': ', s.status) ORDER BY s.position SEPARATOR ', ') FROM watering_stage s WHERE s.run_id = r.id) AS `Stages`,
  r.second_stage_due_at AS `Second stage due at`
FROM (
  SELECT id, status, requested_at, started_at, finished_at, second_stage_due_at,
    CASE
      WHEN status = 'completed' AND actuator_topic IS NOT NULL THEN
        (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 2 AND SUM(s.status = 'completed' AND s.started_at IS NOT NULL AND s.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND s.finished_at >= s.started_at) = 2
          THEN SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, s.started_at, s.finished_at)) ELSE NULL END
         FROM watering_stage s WHERE s.run_id = w.id)
      WHEN status = 'completed' AND actuator_topic IS NULL
        AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at >= started_at
      THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, started_at, finished_at)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS actual_seconds
  FROM watering_run w
  WHERE COALESCE(started_at, requested_at) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
) r
ORDER BY COALESCE(r.started_at, r.requested_at) DESC, r.id DESC
